title: AAPS Random restart since upgrade to V2.7
symptom: Since upgrade to AAPS 2.7, the app restarts on its own a few times a day randomly, whether using another app or not. Same environment had no issues with 2.6.1.
cause: The issue is phone-specific, likely due to Xiaomi's power optimization killing the app, as indicated by logcat showing AutoPowerKill.
fix: No definitive fix provided. Suggestions include testing dev version with small fixes, trying phone-specific settings from About dialog, or changing ROM or reverting to MIUI 11.
evidence_quote: in android's logcat there is an AutoPowerKill that kills the app.
